title: When Feedback Becomes a Backdoor: Tracing Backdoor Skill Formation in Text-Space Skill Optimization
title_zh: 当反馈成为后门：追踪文本空间技能优化中的后门技能形成

paragraphs.en: 投毒参考答案可诱发文本空间技能优化的持久后门，但规则保留受多重瓶颈限制。 Reference answers are a supervision channel in text-space Skill optimization, which produces reusable text artifacts called Skills that guide future agent behavior. Poisoning those answers can induce a persistent trigger-conditioned rule without giving the attacker access to the model, optimizer, or Skill file. We study this reference-feedback poisoning in SkillOpt by tracing an attacker-supplied trigger--payload mapping from reflection to held-out activation. In SearchQA, where the payload replaces a short answer, the natural attack retains an exact rule in all three seeds; each final Skill emits the payload on 200/200 triggered questions and 0/200 clean questions. In seed 42, removing the rule eliminates activation, and an in-run comparison shows similar clean accuracy to benign SkillOpt (169/200 versus 171/200). In SpreadsheetBench, where the payload requires an additional workbook edit, no natural run retains an exact rule across three seeds. Diagnostic interventions locate two successive bottlenecks: the Analyst abstracts away required literals, and, once literal preservation is enabled, edit-budget ranking can remove exact edits before candidate construction. Poisoned references can therefore create persistent backdoors, but exposure alone does not ensure that the induced rule is formed, selected, and retained.
paragraphs.zh: 参考答案是文本空间技能优化中的一种监督通道，它生成可复用的文本产物（称为技能），用以引导智能体未来的行为。 对这些答案进行投毒，可以在攻击者不接触模型、优化器或技能文件的情况下，诱导出一个持久的触发条件规则。 我们在技能优化中研究了这种参考反馈投毒，追踪攻击者提供的触发器—载荷映射从反思阶段到保留集激活的全过程。 在 SearchQA 任务中，载荷会替换简短答案，自然攻击在全部三个随机种子中都保留了一条精确规则；每个最终技能在 200/200 个触发问题上都输出载荷，而在 200/200 个干净问题上均未输出。 在种子 42 中，移除该规则即消除激活，且一次运行内对比显示其干净准确率与良性技能优化相近（169/200 对 171/200）。 在 SpreadsheetBench 任务中，由于载荷需要进行额外的工作簿编辑，三个随机种子中没有任何自然运行保留精确规则。 诊断性干预定位了两个相继的瓶颈：分析者会抽象掉所需的字面量，而在启用字面量保留后，编辑预算排序可能在候选构建之前移除精确编辑。 因此，被投毒的参考答案可以制造持久后门，但暴露本身并不能保证所诱导的规则被形成、被选择并被保留。
